Report!|A clone trooper attempts to contact CT-8508|}} '''CT-8508''' was a [[clone trooper]] and later [[stormtrooper]] who was [[Cloning|created]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] and served the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]]. Under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Clone Commander]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair," he was dispatched to the junkyard planet [[Bracca]] to hunt [[Clone Force 99]], better known as the "Bad Batch." After arriving on Bracca, CT-8508 was sent to hunt secure the Bad Batch's [[Omicron-class attack shuttle|''Omicron''-class attack shuttle]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']]. After finding the ''Marauder'' empty, CT-8508 updated Crosshair on this. He was then ordered by the [[commander]] to maintain a perimeter around the [[shuttle]]. However, he and his stormtroopers were soon [[Death|killed]] by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]], who had come to capture a member of the Bad Batch. A fellow [[trooper]] attempted to contact CT-8508 for a report on the status of the ''Marauder'', but was unable to get a response. ==Biography== ===Mission to Bracca=== {{Quote|Take a shuttle and find their ship.''"
"''Yes, Commander.|CT-9904 and CT-8508|}} CT-8508 was [[Cloning|created]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] and eventually became a stormtrooper and joined the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]], which [[Proclamation of the New Order|begun]] in [[19 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Around that [[Standard year|year]], CT-8508 was deployed under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of the elite [[Stormtrooper Commander]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" on a [[Mission on Bracca|mission]] to the junkyard world{{Databank|bracca|Bracca}} of [[Bracca]] to hunt down the rogue clone unit [[Clone Force 99]], also known as the "Bad Batch." The taskforce traveled to Bracca on three [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttles]] and landed near a [[Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer (Clone Force 99)|scrapped]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] where the Bad Batch had been spotted by the local [[Scrapper Guild]]. [[File:YesCommander.png|thumb|left|300px|CT-8508 signals his fellow troopers.]] The clone [[stormtrooper]]s formed up in lines of five in front of the ''Nu''-class [[shuttle]]s, CT-8508 standing ahead of his own [[squad]], for when Crosshair and his [[Elite Squad|elite squad]] disembarked from one of them. After assessing the Bad Batch's status, the [[commander]] ordered CT-8508 to lead a unit of clones and find the Batch's own [[Starship|vessel]], the [[Omicron-class attack shuttle|''Omicron''-class attack shuttle]] [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']]. The stormtrooper acknowledged and signaled his troops onto a ''Nu''-class shuttle, which took off in search of the the ''Marauder'' once the clones were aboard. ===Demise=== {{Quote|I've taken down so many clones over the years. Once you figure out one, the rest are easy.|Cad Bane, after killing CT-8508 and his comrades|}} [[File:CT8508dead-Reunion.png|thumb|right|300px|Hunter and Omega discover the deceased CT-8508.]] CT-8508 and his fellow clone stormtroopers soon found the ''Marauder'' and searched the shuttle, finding no one inside. The stormtrooper contacted Crosshair, reporting his findings. The commander then ordered him to secure the perimeter, which CT-8508 acknowledged. However, CT-8508 and his clone comrades were attacked by the [[Duros]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]], who was seeking to capture the Bad Batch's youngest member, [[Omega]]. Bane [[Death|killed]] the entire clone unit guarding the ''Marauder'', leaving CT-8508 laying dead at the bottom of the shuttle's boarding ramp. As the Bad Batch members made for their shuttle, a clone stormtrooper with Crosshair attempted to contact CT-8508 for an update, but could not receive a response from the dead trooper. When [[Sergeant]] "[[Hunter]]" and Omega of the Bad Batch arrived at the ''Marauder'' they found Bane and the dead troopers. The [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] jeered at how easy he found it to kill clone troopers, before injuring Hunter and kidnapping Omega. The remaining Bad Batch members soon arrived and brought the [[sergeant]] aboard their shuttle, escaping from Bracca. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Commander.''"
"''What is it?''"
"''We found their ship. There's no one inside.''"
"''Secure the perimeter.''"
"''Yes, sir.|CT-8508 and CT-9904|}} As a clone of the [[human]] male bounty hunter [[Jango Fett]],{{Film|II}} CT-8508 was 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and had [[Color|tan-colored]] skin. He acknowledged and obediently followed all of Crosshair's orders, relaying the commander any update he had. ==Equipment== CT-8508 wore [[Color|white]] [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] and used a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]]. He also made use of a [[comlink]] that was built into his [[helmet]]. ==Behind the scenes== CT-8508 appeared in "[[Reunion]]," the eighth episode of the [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', which was released on [[June 18]], [[2021]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2021|nolive=1}} He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the voice of every clone trooper in ''The Bad Batch'' as well as other animated series including ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@EntertainmentTonight|name=Entertainment Tonight|link=Wikipedia:Entertainment Tonight|video=1UxfT-LUFUE|text=Star Wars: The Bad Batch: Dee Bradley Baker Breaks Down Each Clone's Voice|quote=ET's Ash Crossan spoke with voice actor Dee Bradley Baker, who demonstrates the character voices in the all-new 'Star Wars' animated series, 'The Bad Batch,' now streaming on Disney+.}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Reunion}} {{1st}} *''[[The Bad Batch: Hunted!]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/reunion-episode-guide|text="Reunion" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=CT-8508 |ja=CT-8508 |ka=კს-8508 |pl=CT-8508 |pt=CT-8508 }} [[Category:Clone stormtroopers]] [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Males]]
